newsitem.title: USA: Ionics Inc to supply system to Pemex.
newsitem.headline: Ionics Inc to supply system to Pemex.

text.p: Ionics Inc said on Tuesday it received a contract valued at approximately $3.0 million from Atlatec SA de CV to supply a zero liquid discharge wastewater system at Pemex's Cadereyta Refinery complex in Mexico.
The system will include an Ionics RCC brine concentrator and crystallizer and will treat approximately 170,000 gallons per day of wastewater at the refinery.

Ionics is a separations technology company involved worldwide in the manufacture and sale of membranes and related equipment for the purification, concentration, treatment and analysis of water and wastewater, in the supply of purified water, food and chemical products and in the sale of bottled water and home water purifiers.
